stories.title: Meet the LP: Keebeck Wealth Management
stories.description: The $2.5bn multi-family office has shied away from private equity’s mega-funds due to valuation and liquidity concerns, CEO Bruce K Lee tells PEI Private Equity.

stories.title: The value-add in employee ownership

stories.title: Godspeed Capital targets $1bn for Fund IV, its fourth in five years

stories.title: Side Letter: CalPERS' Cashion on climate
stories.description: Wishing our US readers a happy Thanksgiving. Here’s news on the US's largest public pension and alpha producers to read between helpings.

stories.title: Federated Hermes sees higher PE returns from fee-paying co-invests

stories.title: Siris’ Frank Baker sees tech-enabled services opportunity with new firm October
